column2: While you are out riding, you and your companions are suddenly attacked by a group of bandits, before you can even react, a volley of arrows strikes you, embedding deep into your body, while your companions fall like flies.
You bolt upright in bed. You’re drenched in sweat, struggling to catch your breath. It was a dream,just a dream,but was it really only a dream?
Maybe I should became better person...
